name: Differentiable control
summary: Solve inverse and control problems by backpropagating through the differentiable MLS-MPM rollout. The foundational axis everything else builds on.

tasks.title: Throw a blob to a target by backprop
SGD vs Adam vs L-BFGS through the rollout
tasks.note: How much does the optimizer matter when the gradient comes through 500+ sim steps? Compare convergence and stability of SGD, Adam, and L-BFGS on the throw task. Cheap, and a clean way to build intuition for the loss landscape of a physics rollout.

rework_history.note: We should examine the optimizer comparison across a few varied tasks to be able to make more general claims.
